experiment: P5q relocation-safe fine-grained checkpointed shared frozen-forward and dense bounded-head execution
research_question: With the P5e five-model bounded-JNR candidate and the P5p timing contract unchanged, can the output-equivalent shared-forward cost comparison be executed reproducibly after project relocation, with recoverable analytic and per-model units?
single_changed_axis: Execution durability and path portability only: resolve the project from the installed runner instead of the shell working directory, resolve the MATLAB generator from the relocated E-drive tree, and checkpoint analytic arrays plus every model result. No scientific mechanism, model, feature, input, batch, timing or gate changes.

authorized_environment.fallback_if_windows_driver_rejects_mode_: Proceed only under the unchanged P5h no-external-Python-CUDA guard before launch, after analytic collection, before and after every timing call, and after execution. Record every guard receipt.
authorized_environment.launch_precondition: No external Python CUDA process may exist. Protocol validation, relocation test and no-data/no-CUDA checkpoint recovery self-test must pass before generation.

development_data.roles: evaluation-only; no training, selection, calibration or threshold adjustment
development_data.identity_rule: All five power views remain together; every pool must have zero overlap with every locally retained historical train identity, including quarantined P5p identities.

execution.benchmark_batch: first complete index-ordered batch, indices 0 through 125, no data-dependent sampling
execution.reference: two frozen base forwards plus unchanged dense attachment
execution.candidate: one frozen base forward plus identical unchanged dense attachment
execution.timing: CUDA synchronize before and after every call. Retain all P5h guards and reject any external Python PID whose nvidia-smi pmon type contains C.

checkpoint_contract.project_root: Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]; correctness must not depend on current working directory or drive
immutable_units: per-pool analytic NPZ plus hash receipt
checkpoint_contract.atomic_write: write-fsync-replace; never silently replace a completed receipt
checkpoint_contract.recovery_rule: A completed unit may be reused only after preregistration hash, unit identity and payload/checkpoint hash validation. A started but incomplete analytic unit may use an already atomic and schema-valid NPZ or otherwise recompute. A started but incomplete model unit may recompute only without a completed result and without inspecting unavailable metrics. Recovery may not change code, configuration, data, identities, order, model, thresholds, repetitions or gates.
checkpoint_contract.selection_prohibition: No completed timing/model unit may be selectively rerun. A failed gate is final for that identity pool.
checkpoint_contract.self_test: From an unrelated current working directory and without opening project data or CUDA, validate the protocol, round-trip a synthetic FeatureRole checkpoint exactly, and classify a started incomplete model as recoverable_unobserved_unit.

stop_rule: Any failed protocol/relocation/checkpoint test, invalid/overlapping pool audit, external CUDA Python PID, hash mismatch, output non-equivalence, missing terminal receipt or latency-gate failure stops P5q. Do not tune or regenerate on these identities.

confirmation_if_and_only_if_development_.decision: Only a two-new-identity-pool confirmation pass supports the narrow output-equivalent frozen-execution per-batch cost claim. It is not a classification, architecture, all-parameter or OOD claim.
